title: Exercise owner boundaries for Space member directory and native data export

source.ref: Actual privileged-read functions with synthetic cross-owner records, 2026-10-23

detail: The admin-client ratchet freezes 868 importers; that is not evidence of safe reads. Execute actual listSpaceMemberDirectory and native account-export GET with explicit synthetic dependencies and a query recorder that applies eq/in predicates. Outsiders, signed-out callers, waitlisted members and root requests are denied before privileged roster reads. Authorized A callers see only active visible A members, never B or ghost records; failed reads fail closed. The actual export route ignores query/header target-profile injection, refuses cookie act-as and unsigned callers, and rate-limits before auth. Its actual contract/respond helper keeps exports/errors no-store/private with Authorization/Cookie Vary and hides untyped exception details. Eleven assertion-level reintroduced-bug controls fail; one first attempt timed out and its unchanged isolated rerun fails the intended no-store assertion. Fifty-four existing directory/privacy-export/Loom-download tests and lint pass. No app bug reproduced or app behavior changed in this batch. This is actual-function synthetic evidence, not live RLS/JWT/account/provider proof or coverage of all 868 privileged importers.

verify.note: Actual-function synthetic cross-owner, target-injection, cache and sanitized-error consequences. No database, Auth or provider calls.
